== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (<code>1240_1</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 01), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-01-Arica.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-arica-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_1</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, slip number 01, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
